status: Provisional requirements for implementation and measurement; no test has been performed by this computation.

thermal_path.including: Copper bulk, two end contacts and both pads, at actual clamp/preload and representative vacuum/temperature conditions.
thermal_path.required_heat_acceptance: At least the actual source and normal mount heat histories, including measured added standby. Captured main-resolution direct-path heat export peaks26.1W; this is a modeled value, not a host capability.

required_measurements: Measure all 32 group voltages and individual/group currents, source hottest-cell temperatures and case gradients. Verify fault/reset behavior, initial charge and regeneration limits.
Measure installed path conductance, pad compression and joint repeatability before/after thermal cycling. Validate regulated host temperature at the complete actual heat load.

Instrument copper, GFRP, magnets, pallet, banks, payload interfaces, inverter cases and source plate during twelve releases spaced450s apart and postcampaign coast. Match actual environmental absorptivity/emissivity.
Correlate material-property, contact and warpage models. Establish magnet BH(T), GFRP/adhesive properties, actual payload thermal ICD, contamination/outgassing and vacuum friction/wear acceptance.
claim_boundary: None of these allocations establishes supplier, space, vacuum, flight or universal payload qualification. The thermal path is not yet located in CAD.
